spanish: Haré que Moab deje de ofrecer, dice el Señor, sus altos y quemar incienso a sus dioses.

findings.issue: renders נְאֻם יְהוָה as 'dice el Señor' (wrong lemma, wrong proper name)
uses 'Señor' for יְהוָה instead of licensed Jehová
grammatical smoothing turns participles into infinitives of Moab; number of במה changed to plural
findings.spanishSpan: ofrecer ... sus altos y quemar incienso
